verses.text: We know that our body here on earth is like a tent. If this tent is taken down, we have a building from God in heaven. It is a home not made by human hands, and it lasts for ever.
While we live in this tent, we groan, because we long to put on our home from heaven like clothes.
When we put it on, we will not be found without clothes.
While we are in this tent, we groan under its weight. We do not want to take off our clothes. We want to put on our new clothes, so that what dies will be swallowed up by life.
God made us for this very thing. And he has given us his Spirit as a first payment of what is to come.
So we are always full of courage. We know that while we are at home in this body, we are away from the Lord.
We live by faith, not by what we see.
We are full of courage. We would rather be away from this body and at home with the Lord.
So whether we are at home in the body or away from it, our goal is to please him.
All of us must stand in front of Christ to be judged. Each one will receive what he deserves for what he did while in the body, whether good or bad.
Since we know what it means to fear the Lord, we try to win people over. God knows us fully, and I hope you also know us fully in your hearts.
We are not praising ourselves to you again. We are giving you a reason to be proud of us. Then you can answer those who are proud of how things look on the outside, and not of what is in the heart.
If we seem to be out of our minds, it is for God. If we are in our right minds, it is for you.
Christ's love pushes us on. We are sure of this: one man died for everyone, so everyone has died.
He died for everyone, so that those who live should no longer live for themselves. They should live for Christ, who died for them and was raised to life again.
So from now on we do not judge anyone in a worldly way. Once we thought of Christ in a worldly way, but we do not do that any more.
So if anyone belongs to Christ, he is a new person. The old has gone. Look, the new has come!
All this comes from God. Through Christ he made us his friends again, and he gave us the work of bringing others back to him.
This is the message: God was in Christ, making the world his friend again. He did not hold people's sins against them. And he has given us this message of bringing people back to him.
So we speak for Christ, as if God were calling to you through us. We beg you, for Christ's sake: be friends with God again.
Christ had no sin, but God made him become sin for us. So in Christ we can become right with God.
